title: Hyper-Operations and Coherent Plasmas over $\mathbb{F}_1$
summary: The additive structure of $\mathbb{F}_1$-modules (in the sense of Segal's $Γ$-sets) differs fundamentally from that of abelian groups: addition is encoded through a family of $n$-ary hyper-operations that are multivalued and need not satisfy classical associativity. We establish a \emph{law of generalized associativity} showing that, despite this failure of strict associativity, every $n$-ary sum is contained in the iterated hypersum associated with any partition of its inputs. This enables us to give a hyper-additive description on $π_0$ of Schwede's linearization functor…
